title: Structured Health Coaching Protocol for CHWs
implementation_guidance: Implement a structured health coaching protocol for diabetes self-management that includes: 1) Conducting initial assessment using the Patient Activation Measure to determine baseline self-management capacity; 2) Setting collaborative SMART goals focused on specific behavior changes rather than clinical outcomes; 3) Using teach-back method to verify understanding of diabetes self-care tasks; 4) Implementing regular follow-up schedule with weekly contacts for the first month, then biweekly for two months, and monthly thereafter; 5) Documenting progress using standardized tracking tools that patients can also access; and 6) Applying motivational interviewing techniques with specific emphasis on change talk and affirmations. The protocol should include clear escalation pathways for clinical concerns that arise during coaching sessions.
expected_outcomes: Improved glycemic control with HbA1c reductions, increased diabetes self-efficacy scores, higher rates of medication adherence, improved self-monitoring behaviors, and reduced diabetes-related distress.
target_population: Adults with type 2 diabetes, particularly those with HbA1c > 8%, limited health literacy, or barriers to traditional healthcare access
citation: Palmas W, March D, Darakjy S, et al. Community Health Worker Interventions to Improve Glycemic Control in People with Diabetes: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. J Gen Intern Med. 2015;30(7):1004-1012. doi:10.1007/s11606-015-3247-0
